DpiConfigError.description_en: The list of DPI configuration exceptions

ErrorType.description_en:
The type of the configuration exception. Valid values:

DeviceNotSupported: The SAG device does not support the DPI feature.
VersionNotSupported: The DPI version running Smart Access Gateway device is too low.
NotEnable: The DPI feature is not enabled Smart Access Gateway device
ErrorType.description_zh:
配置异常类型。

**DeviceNotSupported **：智能接入网关设备不支持DPI功能。
**VersionNotSupported **：智能接入网关设备运行的DPI版本过低。
NotEnable：智能接入网关设备的DPI功能未开启

RuleConfigErrorList.description_en: The list of DPI configuration exceptions

DpiGroupIds.description_en: The IDs of the application groups that have configuration exceptions
DpiGroupIds.description_zh: 配置异常的应用组ID列表

items.description_en:
The ID of the application group that has a configuration exception.
You can call the [ListDpiGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196754.html） operation to query application group IDs and the applications contained in each group
items.description_zh:
配置异常的应用组ID。
您可以通过[ListDpiGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196754.html）查询应用组ID及其包含的应用信息

DpiSignatureIds.description_en: The IDs of the applications that have configuration exceptions

items.description_en:
The ID of the application that has a configuration exception.

You can call the [ListDpiSignatures]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196630.html） operation to query application IDs and the corresponding application information
items.description_zh:
配置异常的应用ID。

您可以通过[ListDpiSignatures]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196630.html）查询应用ID及其对应的应用信息

RuleId.description_en:
The instance IDs of the rules associated with the applications that have configuration exceptions.

If you are querying the access control DPI configuration exception information, the instance ID of the access control rule instance that has a configuration exception is displayed.
If you are querying the QoS policy DPI configuration exception information, the instance ID of the 5-tuple-based quintuple rules instance that has a configuration exception is displayed
RuleId.description_zh:
配置异常的应用关联的规则ID列表。

如果您当前查询的是访问控制DPI配置异常信息，则此处显示配置异常的访问控制规则实例ID。
如果您当前查询的是QoS策略DPI配置异常信息，则此处显示配置异常的五元组规则实例ID
